name: Amonkhet
description: Amonkhet is a desert plane of dichotomy, with a lush river valley and glorious city ringed by scorching desert, ruled by animal-headed gods and a God-Pharaoh who was Nicol Bolas ruling in absentia.

description_citations.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary.text: Amonkhet is a desert plane of dichotomy, with a lush river valley and glorious city ringed by scorching desert, ruled by animal-headed gods and a God-Pharaoh who was Nicol Bolas ruling in absentia.

citations.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

bio.text: Its people train their bodies and minds and eagerly anticipate being permitted to die in combat.

citations.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Liliana and Jace both believed Nicol Bolas created the plane, and Bolas rules it in absentia as God-Pharaoh.

citations.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.
"Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.
"Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

bio.text: The city of Naktamun lies on Amonkhet, and the corrupted leylines of the world form the essence of the god Kefnet.

citations.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.
"The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

bio.text: Jace later showed Vraska his memory of breaking into Bolas's mind on Amonkhet.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Years later, Amonkheti racers took part in the Aetherdrift race, with Basri and Zahur among the Champions, and Basri protecting civilians from a dragon's heat with sand that turned to glass.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.
"Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

bio.text: The Amonkheti team crossed the finish line first and received the Aetherspark together as a team.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.
"Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

status.text: The latest event in the material shows the Amonkheti Champions winning the Aetherdrift race and receiving the Aetherspark together as a team.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch's five planeswalkers appear in the middle of an Amonkhet sandstorm.
timeline.quote: Five figures stood where none were moments ago, caught by surprise in the blinding sands.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts sand into a glass dome to shelter the group from the storm.
timeline.quote: I step forward and shape the still-liquid glass into a simple, crude dome.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she knows little of where Bolas is; Nissa senses the plane's leylines are weak, and Chandra spots Bolas's horns on the horizon.
timeline.quote: the massive shadow of two horns pierces the sky

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa senses Amonkhet's life magic is dominated by death.
timeline.quote: the shadow of death dominated all I could reach, as if the world itself favored the silence of the dead.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Undead burst from the sand and grab Jace; the group fights a horde while Liliana commands undead to obey, assist and flee.
timeline.quote: rotting hands burst forth from the sand, grabbed Jace by the legs, and pulled him under.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Giant sand wurms erupt, and one swallows Liliana whole.
timeline.quote: I watched in horror she disappeared into the gullet of an enormous wurm.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, buried under undead, is rescued by Nissa and the two fight toward Chandra.
timeline.quote: Suddenly the limbs of the zombie holding my right arm were no longer attached to its torso.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace's illusion lures a wurm away and Liliana emerges from a dying wurm, wreathed in the Chain Veil's purple light, then collapses.
timeline.quote: I watch, horrified, as Liliana steps forward out of the wurm

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills one wurm from the inside and is flung by another; Jace proposes retreating to Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: I ran forward and leaped into its open maw

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa kills a wurm by driving her sword into its skull.
timeline.quote: she drove her sword with both hands down, piercing its skull with a squish

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: A dead wurm reanimates, strikes Chandra and Jace, and Nissa senses the world is under an ancient curse inverting life and death.
timeline.quote: This world suffered an ancient, powerful curse.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Two zombified wurms attack; one coils around Nissa while Liliana lies in danger, forcing Gideon to choose.
timeline.quote: I stood, suspended, for a fraction of a second, fully aware that not making a choice meant choosing death for them both.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: A blazing white arrow kills the wurm over Liliana and a towering jackal-headed figure destroys the others and saves the group.
timeline.quote: She towered above me, standing at the height of a dozen men, golden headdress gleaming in the sun

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes there are gods on Amonkhet, in the world of Bolas.
timeline.quote: There are gods on Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, ruminating on whether the gods are Bolas's agents or his opponents, trudges through the desert with the group.
timeline.quote: To see gods wading amidst the horrors of the desert had not been among them.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana lounges in a shaded tent, served by mummies, thinking of her hunt for Razaketh and of Nicol Bolas, who brokered her demonic contracts.
timeline.quote: Razaketh would make three.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man appears and chides Liliana for sending shades to search rather than looking herself, and presses her to stay focused on her demon.
timeline.quote: One of your demons is in reach, and time is running out.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man reveals that he took command of the Chain Veil to blast Liliana out of the wurm's belly when she arrived on Amonkhet, which she did not know.
timeline.quote: Didn't I take command of the Chain Veil to blast you out of that wurm's belly when you arrived here?

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana warns the Raven Man to vanish as Jace approaches, and he disappears indignantly.
timeline.quote: "Don't forget why you're here," he said, and vanished indignantly.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace finds Liliana at her tent and they discuss the strange mummies and ambient necromancy of the city.
timeline.quote: it's possible they were raised by some kind of ambient necromancy.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: A shade reports it has found something, and Liliana leads Jace through the city, noticing that all the mummies are maimed.
timeline.quote: Have you noticed that all the mummies in the city are maimed?

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The shade stops at a wall of inscriptions bearing Razaketh's name, which makes Liliana sway.
timeline.quote: The inscription swam in her vision, and whispers pawed at the edges of her awareness.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Jace flee the embalming chamber; Liliana says Razaketh knows she is here and only the Chain Veil stops him activating her contract, and Jace admits Temmet will remember what he saw.
timeline.quote: Chain Veil's the only reason he can't . . . activate my contract.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana decides she needs the others and runs from her demon toward help.
timeline.quote: She ran, away from her demon, toward help.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa wanders the beautiful, empty city and uses her mana sense to perceive the dark strain strangling Amonkhet's leylines.
timeline.quote: A dark virulent strain wove its way through the leylines.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Sixty years earlier, the dragon arrives from another world with only days of magic left to put his plan in motion.
timeline.quote: He had days.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon builds a throne and a horned monument, and plants a promise of his return in the gods and the people.
timeline.quote: he made a promise to return

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Decades later, the second sun settles between the horns and the dragon comes to collect his hoard.
timeline.quote: The time had come for the dragon to return to collect his hoard.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The story recounts the God-Pharaoh's creation myth, in which he forged five gods and set the Trials and the second sun.
timeline.quote: And so the great God-Pharaoh forged the gods.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas roars, declaring the planar bridge his and the army ready, and steps openly out of the shadows.
timeline.quote: was finally taking his first steps, visibly and openly.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace shows Vraska his memory of breaking into Bolas's mind on Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: He was trying to break into Nicol Bolas's mind.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace saw that Ravnica was Bolas's goal.
timeline.quote: Ravnica was writ large upon the ambition in Nicol Bolas's mind.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas scrambles Jace's memories, but a trap Jace's mind carried sends him to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: a part of Jace's mind propelled him from Amonkhet to Ixalan.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Niharet was branded a dissenter and entombed alive by angels, then freed by Mahitab after the Hour of Devastation.
timeline.quote: They wrapped her up and locked her—alive—in that sarcophagus, and then paraded her through the streets.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Rocketeers struggle in the Amonkhet sand as Daretti's goblins are slammed.
timeline.quote: Daretti's guys are getting absolutely slammed out there.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Endriders attack the goblins with flaming chainsaws.
timeline.quote: Worst of all, a flick of a switch on each of the roaring weapons sets them ablaze.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The Speed Demons emerge from the sands in a glitching burst of demonic energy.
timeline.quote: the glowing, ghoulish explosion of demonic energy that can only be the Speed Demons

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Far Fortune faces the demon's veil and unleashes the Endriders' blaze.
timeline.quote: And with that, she unleashes the blaze.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire slices a cannonball in two so that it crashes into Voyager racers.
timeline.quote: A bladed arc of lightning shoots from the grille to slice the cannonball in two.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire glares at Chandra as she passes her.
timeline.quote: That's why Spitfire makes a point of glaring back as she passes Avishkar's favorite daughter.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A Keelhauler hovership rams Chandra and Cloudspire teammates protect her.
timeline.quote: A huge, howling hovership rams against the side of Chandra's bike.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra touches Nissa's pin to remember the stakes.
timeline.quote: She touches the pin Nissa gave her.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: An older Champion dies throwing himself in front of a blow meant for Zahur.
timeline.quote: Basri watches an older member of the Champions throw himself before a wicked slice meant for Zahur.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri lifts the fallen charioteer to the lazotep servants on a cloud of sand.
timeline.quote: On a conjured cloud of sand, he lifts the fallen charioteer.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri leaps between chariots turning sand into blades to fend off insects.
timeline.quote: he leaps from one to the other, like stones across a pond, while turning the sand around him into slicing blades

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire finds herself in sixth place and renews her resolve for the Aetherspark.
timeline.quote: Sixth place.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire launches off a god statue's spear to pass the goblins.
timeline.quote: she launches off the tip of the old god's spear.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A fireball blasts away glitch ghosts that were attacking Spitfire, though its heat scorches her.
timeline.quote: Until a scintillating fireball blasts them away, replacing one threat with another

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita secretly thanks her rescuer in her cockpit.
timeline.quote: Beneath the mask, in the privacy of her own ride, Sita mutters her thanks.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Winter, who answers that those old enough to race are old enough to die.
timeline.quote: If they're old enough to race, they're old enough to die.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Blue flame engulfs Winter and the demon roars.
timeline.quote: This time, blue flames sear through Winter's skin.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The demon's claw knocks a wheel off the Champions' lead chariot and sends them toward a statue.
timeline.quote: The claw that would have torn Chandra apart instead knocks a wheel free from the lead chariot.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra hurls a fireball that sends the Speed Demons spinning into a dune.
timeline.quote: Chandra hurls the fireball so hard that only a desperate grab for the handle keeps her from becoming a bright orange smear against the pavement.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The caged creature yelps when the fireball hits the Speed Demons, leaving Chandra uneasy.
timeline.quote: When her fireball hit the Speed Demons, the little guy in the cage yelped.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: An Omenpath opens at the end of the Amonkhet track, leading to Muraganda.
timeline.quote: Up ahead, an Omenpath ripples at the end of the track.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A huge dust storm swallows the Guidelight Voyagers as the others flee through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: In the rearview mirror, Spitfire watches the Guidelight Voyagers, automatons captained by Mendicant Core, as they're swallowed up in the storm.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire waits for the Amonkheti to cut through a tree rather than use Chandra's tunnel.
timeline.quote: she throws the ride into reverse and waits for the Amonkheti to slice through the tree.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A moonfall quake begins and the Amonkheti chariot hippo bolts for shelter.
timeline.quote: Sure enough, the gentle tremble beneath them intensifies into a hungry growl from the earth.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The rocket car spirals out of the Omenpath above an oasis on Amonkhet instead of reaching Avishkar.
timeline.quote: the rocket car spirals into the air above an oasis on Amonkhet

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra blasts the ground with fire, boiling the oasis water.
timeline.quote: she blasts the ground ahead of them with a gout of fire.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The car crashes into the oasis.
timeline.quote: An instant later, the ship hits the earth.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra wakes first, concussed, and checks on the others.
timeline.quote: Chandra's the first one to wake beneath the warm sun of Amonkhet.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti offers medicine for the concussions and hands Chandra a cup.
timeline.quote: If you need medicine, I've plenty.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti concludes the engine is blown and they must improvise from scrap.
timeline.quote: I regret to inform you we've blown the engine.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia assigns Chandra to be her welding torch.
timeline.quote: are going to be your dear sweet mother's personal welding torch.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti, Pia and Chandra build an all-new engine from palm fibers, hippo bones and scrap.
timeline.quote: I believe we're developing an all-new type of engine here, purely out of desperation.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti takes over the night work on the engine.
timeline.quote: I think that's most of the welding work done for the evening.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Loot encourages Chandra that when you see something wrong you fix it.
timeline.quote: When you see things that are wrong, you fix them.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia asks why Chandra did not race with the Aether Rangers.
timeline.quote: why didn't you want to race with us?

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra confides she feared losing Nissa's second chance at a spark and fears telling her she failed.
timeline.quote: We can't lose her second chance at a spark, too.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia comforts Chandra, saying they improvise and find other ways when things do not work out.
timeline.quote: We find other ways to be.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A lion-masked god appears beside Chandra at the oasis in the night.
timeline.quote: a very tall, powerfully built man with a lion's head.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The god explains that Bolas could not kill the spirit of Amonkhet's gods.
timeline.quote: Bolas thought he had strangled our spirit within his claws, but what do you see around you?

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The god asks only to hear of other worlds in return for his counsel.
timeline.quote: It would delight me if you told me of the other worlds, about how they live and in what they believe.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells the god about Zendikar, her girlfriend's favorite place.
timeline.quote: my girlfriend's favorite place in the Multiverse is called Zendikar.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia hot-wires the cobbled-together car.
timeline.quote: Pia's rubbing two wires together beneath the steering wheel.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra says Ketramose gave directions to an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Ketramose said if we head this way for an hour or two, we should see it

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra realizes Winter used Loot to find secret Omenpaths as shortcuts.
timeline.quote: He made you show him where the other Omenpaths are, the ones nobody else knows about.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri shields civilians with sand that turns to glass in the dragon's heat.
timeline.quote: Basri Ket conjured waves of sand to shield the fleeing civilians

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.
